# formatPortholeAge

An age in ms as short English words, rounded down so it never claims more recent than it is: `"less than a minute"`, `"4 min"`, `"3 hr"`, `"1 day"`, `"2 days"`. It never counts seconds, so the words change at most once a minute.

```tsx
import { formatPortholeAge } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/porthole-view";
```

## Example

```tsx
formatPortholeAge(4 * 60_000 + 59_000); // "4 min"
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `age` | `number` |

## Returns

`string`
